attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate CA state corporate income tax. Applies 8.84% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Enforces $800 minimum franchise tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have CA nexus; (apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true) and apportionment.state_code == "CA"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if { pop apportionment.state_code "CA" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CA income tax at 8.84% with $800 minimum; // Calculate CA income tax at 8.84%, enforce $800 minimum; set apportionment.state_tax = max(result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax, apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_dsl: if apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits > result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax then set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits; else set apportionment.state_tax = result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax; endif set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: { apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits f- cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef } { result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef } apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits f- result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax f> ifelse apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: No income but still owe minimum franchise tax; // No CA taxable income, but $800 minimum franchise tax still applies; set apportionment.state_tax = result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = result.ca_minimum_franchise_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
